title: Earthy
summary: Mushrooms, beets, lentils, cumin — depth from roasting and long simmering.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — earthy is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: root_veg, mushroom, warm_spice. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Toast spices in fat before wet ingredients
Fresh acid and herbs on top keep earthiness from feeling heavy.
